changelog:
Initial release of the Fulcra personal concierge orchestration layer.

- Introduces a seamless "front door" that stitches together all major concierge skills into a single, smooth daily flow.
- Handles both morning ("start my day") and evening ("wrap up my day") sequences automatically, including special Sunday/Monday weekly insights.
- Contextually routes mid-day requests to the appropriate sub-skill for individual tasks.
- Performs graceful degradation: transparently skips unavailable skills while continuing the sequence and informing the user of any omissions.
- Preserves privacy by avoiding exposure of sensitive data or secrets.
